svg.title: Bazaar Crossing V2 demolition map top-down plan
svg.desc: Exact six-pixels-per-metre plan of the 136 by 112 metre V2 runtime collision layout: an enterable A merchant court, roofed B warehouse, four-room S-shaped Mid, folded north back market, full-height closure masses, ten ground doors, and three local upper positions.
svg.text: RUNTIME COLLISION PLAN · 6 px / m · WORLD x[-68,68], z[-56,56] · NORTH = -Z

g.text: FOLDED ROOFED BACK MARKET · ≥4 HARD TURNS

svg.text: V2 replaces the former open mirrored plane. Geometry follows current C# collision extents; authored art must preserve every wall, door, return and roof boundary.
